name: SEO Blog Writing Standards
body:
> Sop · 2026-06-12

# Summary
TAG's checklist that every client blog draft (Alphalete, Summit, Pipeliners, and by extension Prestige) must pass before delivery. Compiled June 12 2026 from Yoast, Semrush and Backlinko guidance. It covers keyphrase placement, titles, metas, structure, linking, images, schema and AI-search visibility, and ends with a 10-point pre-delivery verification.

# Key rules
- **Focus keyphrase (non-negotiable):** the exact keyphrase appears contiguously in the title/H1, ideally at the start. If it reads badly, change the keyphrase and update the tracker; never ship a mismatch. Also in SEO title (first 60 chars), meta description, slug, first paragraph, at least one H2 and one image alt.
- **One keyphrase per post**, cannibalization check against the tracker and existing pages first. Density about 1 to 2 percent at most.
- **Title/H1:** one H1 only; SEO title under 60 characters, brand suffix last; no claims the post does not support.
- **Meta description:** 155 characters max, contains the keyphrase, action verb and reason to click.
- **Slug:** short, hyphenated, keyphrase, no dates.
- **Structure:** H2/H3 hierarchy with no skipped levels; "Quick answer" lead paragraph (2 to 3 sentences); question H2s answered in the first sentence; FAQ of 3 to 5 questions near the end (FAQ schema must match visible content).
- **Body:** about 1,000 to 1,500 words for supporting posts, 1,500+ for pillars. Informational intent only; transactional terms belong to service pages. Every spec, price or cadence claim must be backed by the live site, owner or an authoritative source.
- **Linking:** 3 to 5 internal links minimum (pillar, sibling, money page, conversion page); hub and spoke structure; descriptive anchors.
- **Never mention or link a competitor** (examples named include Roto-Rooter, Mr. Rooter, Goettl, Parker and Sons). Cite only neutral authorities (EPA, USGS, DOE, municipal water).
- **Images:** descriptive file names and alt text, compressed.
- **Schema/technical:** Article/BlogPosting schema (verify, do not duplicate); after publishing, request indexing in GSC, confirm sitemap, add to tracker.
- **AI search:** self-contained quotable answer sentences; Quick answer and FAQ entries are the most cited fragments.

# Pre-delivery verification (10 checks)
1. Keyphrase in title/H1, SEO title, slug, meta, first paragraph, an H2.
2. SEO title 60 chars or less, meta 155 or less.
3. One H1, clean heading hierarchy.
4. Quick answer and FAQ present.
5. Internal links verified against the site inventory.
6. No em dashes, no unbacked claims.
7. HTML tag balance and word count.
8. Cannibalization check.
9. Zero competitor names or links; list every external domain.
10. Every link loads (.gov pages may 403 to bots; confirm in a browser).
